hero_section.description: Kinetic hero centerpiece containing the line-by-line masked headline reveal, the tactile big increment button with ripple/burst particle effects, and the giant reactive digital readout.
features: Masked line-by-line headline reveal on mount
Giant responsive count readout with spring digit animation
Tactile primary increment button with Web Audio click feedback, particle burst canvas, and ripple expander
Velocity meter indicator showing clicks-per-second
Reset & Quick Increment modifier controls (+1, +10, +100, Reset)
Session streak & milestone celebrate toast triggers

editorial_marquee.description: Slow, elegant kinetic ribbon ticker with low contrast typography creating continuous architectural momentum across the viewport.
features: Infinite smooth horizontal drift powered by framer-motion or CSS keyframes
Serif & Monospace typography blend
Interactive hover pause or speed shift

manifesto_chapters.description: Numbered 4-chapter manifesto breakdown analyzing the philosophy of counting, tactile interaction, and transient digital states.
features: Chapter I: The Primal Act of Counting
Chapter II: Kinetic Accumulation & Physics
Chapter III: The Ephemeral State (No Database, Pure Presence)
Chapter IV: Architectural Harmony in UI Design
Interactive chapter accordions / interactive focus cards

analytics_dashboard.description: High-density minimal telemetry card showing live session metrics: total clicks, peak velocity, average click rhythm, click time breakdown, and session age timer.
features: Live session stats counters
Click velocity gauge meter
Interactive milestone achievements tracker (e.g., '10 Clicks: Origin', '50 Clicks: Momentum', '100 Clicks: Kinetic Master')
Live chart visualization of click rhythm using Recharts/SVG

spatial_3d_canvas.description: Subtle Three.js / Canvas 3D floating kinetic mathematical shapes or light-shadow geometry that rotates dynamically according to cursor position and click count.
features: Interactive 3D geometry canvas reacting to counter value
Light/shadow minimal aesthetic matching bone-white theme
Smooth fallback for lower powered devices

header_nav.description: Floating glassmorphic navigation with live counter badge, audio toggle switch, theme switcher, and scroll indicator.
features: Glassmorphism blur background with subtle border
Synthesized Audio Toggle (Click SFX state)
Live Mini-Counter Indicator in header
Quick Reset button in Header

footer_section.description: Bold editorial footer with massive oversized branding signature, system status indicator, and copyright.
features: Massive text signature: 'COUNT. OBSERVE. REPEAT.'
Live session time indicator
Reset counter action with confirmation dialog

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the hero increment button is extremely prominent, tactile, and satisfying with spring motion and visual click bursts.
Implement Web Audio API synthesized click sound effects with a toggle button in the navbar.
Maintain a clean, minimal, light architectural aesthetic with warm off-white background (#F8F7F4), deep charcoal text (#0D0D0D), and vibrant kinetic orange accent (#FF3E20).
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations, digit flip/slide number transitions, and line-by-line masked text reveals.
Include live telemetry/metrics showing click speed (clicks/sec), session streak, achievement milestone unlocks, and a quick reset mechanism.
Include data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements as specified in test_ids.
